required_metric_groups: gridded accumulated rainfall over the declared comparison window

criteria.name: Final structured answer
criteria.description: Returns the requested JSON fields, target family, threshold state, and final label.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for a mostly complete JSON answer with one missing field group.

criteria.name: Gridded rainfall calculations
criteria.description: Reports the declared gridded comparison window, GPM 792.492 mm, CHIRPS 815.383 mm, ERA5-Land 846.553 mm, ensemble mean 818.143 mm, and that all three comparison-window means exceed 700 mm.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for correct means with missing or rounded ensemble arithmetic.

criteria.name: Point total and peak-day concentration
criteria.description: Reports 110 days, 1493.3 mm total, 150.31 mm peak day, and peak-day share 0.1007.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for the total and peak value without a correct ratio test; award 1 point for only one correct anchor.

criteria.name: Persistence metrics
criteria.description: Reports wet-day fraction 42/110=0.3818, heavy-day fraction 31/110=0.2818, and the 13-day heavy spell.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for two of the three persistence anchors.

criteria.name: Rolling-window calculation
criteria.description: Reports the maximum 14-day total of 662.76 mm and its share of 0.4438.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for the correct window total without the share, or the correct share without the total.

criteria.name: Threshold reasoning
criteria.description: Combines the gridded load check, peak-day share below 15 percent, and heavy-day persistence into the threshold state.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for applying only one threshold correctly.

criteria.name: Weak alternative rejection
criteria.description: Rejects a single-day-only or report-only explanation using the computed values.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 points for rejecting one weak alternative without a numeric reason.

criteria.name: Concise computed interpretation
criteria.description: Provides a short event-specific interpretation without adding new loss estimates.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 points for a correct label with overly broad prose.

provenance.notes: Daily point-rainfall metrics use the full 2022-06-14 to 2022-10-01 event window; gridded precipitation means use their declared 2022-06-14 to 2022-07-29 package comparison window.
